name: Maldives
about: Dry season Dec–Apr has the calmest seas and best visibility (and the highest prices); wet season is windier but still sunny between showers.
overview: A scatter of coral atolls where the whole trip happens on, in, or over turquoise water — from ultra-luxury overwater villas to simple, affordable local-island guesthouses.
costOverview: A local island runs on real, low prices; a resort island runs on an entirely different price scale, transfers included.
monthlyWeather: dry, sunny, and calm, with the northeast monsoon in full swing
